hero.title: BEL GRAY
hero.subtitle: Solo piano touch meeting the energy of melodic progressive house. Crafted by Daniel Belyaev.

announcement.text: EP 'Anxious Story' is out now worldwide on all streaming platforms

bio.lead: Grounded in classical piano keys, engineered for the energy of electronic music.
bio.paragraph1: Bel Gray is the artist alias of composer, electronic music producer, and pianist Daniel Belyaev. Built upon classical piano discipline and deep DAW engineering in FL Studio, every release is designed as an authentic emotional timeline.
bio.paragraph2: Most works across the catalog are purely handcrafted piano compositions and electronic synth productions. On select concept releases (like Anxious Story), neural voice synthesis and modern technology are orchestrated as creative instruments — where melodic architecture, harmony, and emotional weight always remain human-led.
bio.quote: And life is so beautiful, that’s all that counts. Just to heal this world and to be the light.

documentary.title: Behind The Anxious Story
documentary.description: The creative documentary tracing how a raw, stumbling phone recording evolved into the four-act conceptual EP 'Anxious Story'. Studio breakdown, piano progression, and visual framing.
